name: Kouno Mio
source:
Another character being able to use "modern magic". Her father happened to be Shuu's grandfather's student, explaining her knowledge in the special magic style. She is from the same class as Yuka, Kakeru, Shione and Shuu.

[From [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/11eyes#New_characters_in_11eyes_CrossOver]Wikipedia[/url]]
